input: Find a local drum circle to join monthly

gold.taskTitle: Find and Join a Local Monthly Drum Circle
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to locate a recurring local drum circle they can attend on a monthly basis.

questions.title: What city or neighborhood should the search focus on?
questions.description: Identify the specific location or radius the user considers 'local' for finding drum circles.

questions.title: Do you already play drums or are you a beginner?
questions.description: Understand the user's current skill level to match them with beginner-friendly or experienced groups.

questions.title: What style of drumming most interests you?
questions.description: Clarify preferred drumming style, such as West African, Brazilian, Native American, or open freestyle.

questions.title: Which day of the week works best for you?
questions.description: Determine scheduling availability to filter drum circles that meet on compatible days.

questions.title: Do you own a drum or need one provided?
questions.description: Find out whether the user has their own instrument or needs a circle that supplies or loans drums.

questions.title: Are you looking for a free event or willing to pay?
questions.description: Understand budget expectations, as some drum circles are free community events while others charge a fee.

questions.title: Is this for personal enjoyment, social connection, or wellness?
questions.description: Clarify the primary motivation to help prioritize the type and atmosphere of drum circle that fits best.
